calculation.description: For each tradable asset, compute 60-day cumulative return relative to the equal-weight benchmark, multiply by centered 40-day relative-return breadth, normalize by 40-day relative volatility, and lag the signal by one completed trading day. Higher values indicate persistent relative leadership confirmed by broad positive relative participation.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across all evaluated regimes: 2024-2026 IC 0.06831/ICIR 0.22156 over 93 dates; 2027-2029 IC 0.03795/ICIR 0.14253 over 782 dates; 2030-2032 IC 0.02565/ICIR 0.10065 over 647 dates. No qualifying 2020-2023 dates due to data warmup/forward horizon.
validation.decay: Validated at the 10-trading-day decision horizon; other horizons not evaluated in this cycle.
